$comment: Per-financial-year SOCSO (PERKESO, Act 4) config. Tables are referenced by id: 'socso-act4-2024-10' lives in socso-act4-2025.json; 'socso-act4-a1788' phases live in socso-act4-2026.json. Periods are inclusive calendar dates on CONTRIBUTION MONTHS (SOCSO is assessed per calendar month of wages; a month's wages are those payable for wage periods ending in that month). See docs/research/socso.md. Researched 2026-11-04; revised 2026-11-05 after the deep verification pass. Fields with status 'owner-decision' are open questions listed in the report and must not be treated as decided.

notes: RM6,000 ceiling in force since contribution month Oct 2024 (Act A1724 s.2; P.U.(B) 381/2024; Employers' Circular 3/2024 para 3.3). PERKESO allowed a no-penalty transition for employers from 1 Oct 2024 to 31 Mar 2025. No separate transition table exists, so the calculator ignores it, but a real Jan-Mar 2025 payslip from a late employer may differ.

June 2026 NEI is mandatory and non-refundable even for people who later opted out (PERKESO FAQ v2.3 Q11, Q12, Q22). One narrow possible exception: Q13 allows a refund for a non-selected employer where someone has several employers.
Many payrolls (e.g. the government's iGFMAS) did not deduct NEI in June 2026 pay and recovered it later as arrears. Real June payslips may therefore differ from the legally due amount.

An opt-out takes effect when PERKESO receives it, and cover ends then (FAQ v2.3 Q47, Q51). Refunds run from contribution month July 2026 depending on the opt-out period (Q14). PERKESO has published no month-by-month rule. July NEI for someone who filed in August is unconfirmed: see optOutEffect.
Refunds are claimed only by the employer through ASSIST (Q15, Q16), so a July or August payslip can show NEI that is later refunded.
Same amounts as Jul-Aug 2026; only the participation label changes.
Opting back in is allowed at any time, online from 2 Sep 2026 (PERKESO release 9 Sep 2026), not backdated, and costs NEI on the full month's wage for the month of opt-in (FAQ v2.3 Q6, Q7, Q45).

2027.statusNote: Nothing announced changes Act 4 rates or the RM6,000 ceiling for 2027 as of 2026-11-05 (MOF Budget 2027 speech and tax measures; PERKESO release 11 Oct 2026; Parliament bill list to D.R.27/2026; Federal Legislation listing to early Nov 2026, which is a saved AGC portal listing, unconfirmed: not relied on (D1) until a manual check at lom.agc.gov.my). NEI Phase 1 runs to 31 May 2028 under P.U.(B) 196/2026. PERKESO and KESUMA said they would review the LINDUNG 24 Jam mechanism by end-2026 and propose Act 4 amendments if needed; no outcome found. Re-verify in Jan 2027.

notes: Phase dates and tables are law. The ceiling and participation fields on these periods are carried forward from today's rules and are not legislated forecasts.

optOutEffect.$comment: PERKESO has published no month-by-month rule. Calculator default is an owner decision (see report).

calculatorDefault.recommended: NEI 0 from July 2026 for anyone flagged opted out, labelled net of any refund, with a caveat for August filers

wageRules.$comment: Year-independent. Act 4 s.2(24) untouched by A1724 and A1788. monthlyWage = counted components for wage periods ending in that month, BEFORE employee EPF, SOCSO and EIS deductions. Third Schedule para 1A up to May 2026; para 2 from June 2026.

counted.item: basic salary, overtime, leave and holiday pay, extra work on holidays
allowances fixed or variable: incentive, shift, meal, cost of living, housing
fixed phone allowance not reimbursing work costs
bonus or incentive paid more often than yearly
leave encashment on resignation, in the final wage month

excluded.item: 13th-month or AWS paid once a year
festive bonus paid once a year
travel or mileage claims; toll or parking claims against receipts; expense reimbursements
gratuity on discharge or retirement; retrenchment or dismissal payments
employer EPF, SOCSO and EIS shares

ownerDecision.item: fixed monthly travel, transport, petrol, toll or parking allowance
ownerDecision.recommended: exclude per s.2(24)(b), with a 'my payslip counts this' toggle
ownerDecision.conflict: Statute says 'any travelling allowance'; PERKESO booklets exclude only claims; PERKESO Threads post 7 Feb 2026 counts transport allowance.

arrears.rule: Arrears and backdated increments belong to the month earned, not the month paid. Re-run each earned month with its corrected wage, using that month's table, category and NEI status. Never add arrears to the current month's wage for band lookup.
arrears.basis: Third Schedule para 1A and A1788 para 2; s.9(1); s.7(2) proviso; ASSIST arrears function
arrears.outOfConfig: Earned months before 2024-10 need the older RM5,000-ceiling table, which is not in this config: warn instead of computing.

wageRules.zeroWages: No contribution for a month in which no wages are payable (s.9(1): 'and not otherwise'). The test is wages payable, not paid.

multipleEmployers.rule: Employment injury and invalidity are computed per employer on that employer's wage; the RM6,000 ceiling applies per job. NEI goes through at most one employer: zero times for an opted-out local, once otherwise, on the chosen employer's band.
multipleEmployers.selectionWindow: 30 days from the date PERKESO's written notice is furnished. Applies whenever someone has two or more employers, not only on 1 Jun 2026. If no choice, PERKESO notifies the employer within 14 days.
perkesoDefaultOrder: employer named in a non-employment-injury benefit application

selfEmployedActs789.$comment: LINDUNG Kendiri / SKSPS (Act 789). Store RM amounts, never compute them: 1.25% of insured earnings fits only at nearest 10 sen (each value is a tie at 5 sen), and 'matching percentages' are nominal.
